description: Relay operator set and certificate (pp-browser projects/release-compatibility/SIGNED_FORMATS.md § 3, § 6). Keys are ML-DSA-65 from a 32-byte seed of one repeated byte, typed (alg id 1 first). Every case is read at now_ms against pinned_relay_id, asked at asked_origin, holding the certificate of the case `held` names: `verdict` is the certificate's (accepted, older, needs_update, malformed, forged, other_relay, expired, invalid), `outcome` what the client does (adopted, same, lower, conflict, origin_not_listed; refused). Signatures are hedged: certificate_b64 and change_b64 are frozen as written, every other value is rebuilt exactly.

cases.name: certificate_1
cases.description: sequence 1 for transport key 1, signed by operators 1 and 3 of the 2-of-3 set: kept

cases.name: certificate_2
cases.description: sequence 2 for a new transport key (a host move): kept over certificate 1

cases.name: certificate_2_again
cases.description: certificate 2 offered while it is held, byte for byte: nothing changes

cases.name: with_set_change
cases.description: operator 3 replaced by operator 4 (set generation 2, signed by operators 1 and 2 of the founding set); sequence 3 signed by operators 2 and 4 of the new set: kept, the relay id unchanged

cases.name: unknown_non_critical_entry
cases.description: sequence 4 with an unknown non-critical entry (type 0x0001): verifies, kept with its bytes

cases.name: one_signature
cases.description: only operator 1 signed: the 2-of-3 set needs two

cases.name: index_twice
cases.description: operator 1's signature twice under its index: two signatures, one operator

cases.name: signer_index_outside_set
cases.description: a second signature under index 3 of a 3-key set

cases.name: key_outside_set
cases.description: operator 1 and a key outside the set (under operator 3's index)

cases.name: other_relay_id
cases.description: a valid certificate of another relay (its 1-of-1 set), served for ours

cases.name: lower_sequence
cases.description: certificate 1 offered while certificate 2 is held: never below

cases.name: same_sequence_other_bytes
cases.description: another sequence-2 certificate (issued a millisecond later) while certificate 2 is held: refused, logged as an error, the first stays

cases.name: origin_not_listed
cases.description: certificate 1 served at an origin it does not list (a relay fronting another)

cases.name: expires_at_past
cases.description: sequence 5 that expired before the time it is read at

cases.name: unknown_critical_entry
cases.description: sequence 5 with an unknown critical entry (type 0x8001): verifies, then update needed

cases.name: version_2
cases.description: certificate 1 with version byte 2: update needed, nothing verified

cases.name: version_0
cases.description: certificate 1 with version byte 0: made by an older tool

cases.name: truncated
cases.description: certificate 1 without its last byte

cases.name: set_change_skips_a_generation
cases.description: a set change of generation 3 after the founding set (generation 1)

cases.name: transport_key_is_an_operator_key
cases.description: sequence 5 whose transport key is operator 2's
